rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 18 years old to be counted as an adult for Council Tax purposes

rules.description: Applicant must be the only adult (18+) resident in the property
rules.reason_if_failed: The single person discount only applies if you are the only adult living in the property

rules.description: Applicant must be liable for Council Tax on the property
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be liable for Council Tax on this property to claim the discount

rules.description: Property must be the applicant's main residence
rules.reason_if_failed: The property must be your main home to qualify for the discount

rules.description: Applicant must have a qualifying reason for living alone
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have experienced bereavement, separation, or a household member moving out to apply

explanation_template: Council Tax single person discount eligibility: {outcome}

edge_cases.description: Property has other adults who are disregarded for Council Tax (students, care workers, severely mentally impaired)
edge_cases.action: Council will verify disregarded status. Applicant may still qualify if only disregarded persons live with them.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has children under 18 in shared custody arrangements
edge_cases.action: Children under 18 don't affect eligibility. Council will confirm custody arrangements don't involve other adults residing in property.

edge_cases.description: Applicant or other resident is temporarily absent (hospital, prison, work)
edge_cases.action: Council will assess whether absence is temporary and how it affects residency status. May require evidence and review.

edge_cases.description: Applicant owns or is liable for Council Tax on multiple properties
edge_cases.action: Council will determine which property is the main residence. Discount only applies to main home.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a live-in carer providing care
edge_cases.action: Carers providing at least 35 hours/week care may be disregarded. Council will verify carer status and hours.

edge_cases.description: Applicant previously had a claim rejected or discount removed
edge_cases.action: Council will review circumstances that have changed since previous decision. May trigger additional verification.
